page.layout: One binding cover, no printed text block. Blind-tooled ornamental border and frame on the cover; a small tooled label at the top with a few capital letters; handwritten date at the bottom; spine with raised bands at the left edge.
page.notes: This is the outer cover of a binding, not a printed page. The tooled label at the top shows only a few worn capitals that I cannot read reliably (roughly "T O P C P", uncertain). The handwritten "1582" in brown ink at the foot is handwriting, so it is not transcribed. Stains, wear and the spine bands are not text. No printed words to transcribe.
